name: Kurosaki Ranmaru
source:
The senior of Masato Hijirikawa and Ren Jinguuji. He's a rather harsh idol who likes rock music. Tends to get along better with Camus when Reiji is being goofy. His instrument is the bass.

[Edited from [url=http://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Uta_no_Prince-sama]Wikipedia[/url]]
